name: Rory
help: Upload a ShiftCare export of vacant shifts and a staff availability CSV. Rory removes anyone on the do-not-send list, already rostered, unavailable or missing a required check, ranks the rest (preferred list first) and drafts the SMS offer. A person approves the offer and assigns the shift in ShiftCare.
onApprove: Offer marked as sent (nothing was actually sent). Assigning the shift in ShiftCare stays a human step.

name: Sunny
help: Upload a ShiftCare shift export with clock-in times and whether a note was submitted. Sunny flags shifts with no sign-in 15 minutes after start (on-call is told after 30), late sign-ins, and finished shifts with no progress note, and drafts the nudge.
onApprove: Nudge marked as sent (nothing was actually sent).

name: Lenny
help: Upload the roster and the timesheet export from ShiftCare. Lenny flags time worked ≠ rostered, shifts over 10 hours (overtime check), broken shifts that need the allowance, and breaks under 10 hours between shifts. SCHADS rules here are simplified SAMPLE rules: confirm against the award before payroll.
onApprove: Payroll flag accepted. Nothing was written to ShiftCare or payroll.

name: Indy
help: Paste the worker's account of what happened. Indy drafts the incident report in sections, suggests whether it may be reportable to the NDIS Commission and which clock applies (24 hours or 5 business days). Indy never lodges anything: a person decides and lodges.
onApprove: Incident report draft approved and a sample ClickUp task created to lodge it. Nothing was lodged with the NDIS Commission.

inputs.label: What happened (worker's account)
inputs.sample: Shift SH-5502, 14 Oct 2026, 9:00am to 1:00pm. Mia Castellano became upset when asked to shower. Tom Brennan held her arms to stop her hitting him. Mia hit her head on the door frame and has a small bruise on her forehead. Ice pack applied at 10:15am. Called her mum on 0412 345 678. No ambulance.

name: Chase
help: Upload the incident action list (from ShiftCare incidents or ClickUp). Chase lists every open action that is overdue or due within 3 days and drafts the follow-up to its owner, until it is done.
onApprove: Follow-up marked as sent (nothing was actually sent).

name: Archie
help: Upload a participant file checklist. Archie thinks like an auditor and lists missing or out-of-date evidence against the NDIS Practice Standards: signed service agreement, consent, risk assessment and support plan reviewed in the last 12 months, behaviour support plan where required, emergency plan, and recorded goals.
onApprove: Gap accepted and a sample ClickUp task created to fix it.

name: Sage
help: Upload plan details. Sage drafts the service agreement schedule of supports (item, rate, hours, estimated cost against the core budget) and flags agreements ending within 60 days or after the plan ends. A coordinator approves before it goes for signature.
onApprove: Agreement draft approved and marked ready for signature (nothing was sent).

name: Val
help: Upload a list of incoming files (or file names). Val works out the document type, who it belongs to, the expiry date if the name shows one, and the folder it should go in. Anything Val can't place is marked for a person.
onApprove: Filing approved (sample record only; no file was moved).

name: Wizard
help: Upload a history of approved progress notes. Wizard counts signals per participant per week (escalations, refusals, poor sleep, low mood) and flags anything rising over the last 4 weeks, with the notes behind it. A flag is a reason to look, never a diagnosis. The 7am brief lists what is waiting in the review queue.
onApprove: Trend acknowledged; the team leader will review the notes. Nothing changed in ShiftCare.

name: Leads & recruitment
help: Upload the pipeline (participant enquiries and job applicants, e.g. a ClickUp list export). The tracker drafts the next step for each one (reply, intake call, interview, chase missing documents) and flags anything with no contact for 7+ days. Approving creates a sample ClickUp task.
onApprove: Next step approved and a sample ClickUp task created. Nothing was sent.
